title: Machine learning predicts acute kidney injury after off-pump coronary bypass surgery
summary: On 938 off-pump bypass patients (210 with acute kidney injury, 22.39%), XGBoost on baseline and Tsfresh-extracted intraoperative time-series features was the best of the models tried. In external validation of 631 patients it reached AUC 0.982, accuracy 0.916 and precision 0.983; SHAP ranked cystatin C first and NT-proBNP second. The study is retrospective and the very high external AUC calls for prospective confirmation.
ai_technology: XGBoost with Tsfresh time-series feature extraction and SHAP ranking
organization: Jiangsu Province Hospital; Nanjing Medical University

evidence.tested: Retrospective development at one hospital and external validation in 631 patients (85 with injury) at a second hospital.
evidence.unknown: Prospective validation and effect on patient outcomes; prediction only.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts postoperative acute kidney injury risk
